snippet.title: MUSE TRAILER 2 | EN
snippet.description:
Step into the dreamlike world of Muse, a psychological visual novel where art, emotion, and memory intertwine. Follow Clara, a young artist facing a creative breakdown, as she’s guided by a mysterious muse through surreal landscapes shaped by her fears and insecurities.

Muse is an atmospheric, emotional story about the struggles of creativity, mental health, and self-expression — told through art and dreamlike imagery.
